svg.title: Changing scope can reverse the first-pass decision
svg.desc: Cow 10 has 93 calls among 120 markers and enters the first high-density pass genome-wide. She has zero calls among the 24 markers on X, so chromosome scope skips her there. Cow 88 has 45 of 120 markers called (37.5%), so the genome-wide first pass skips her. Chromosome scope includes her on chromosome 1 (24/48, 50%). Chromosome 2 (14/48) and X (7/24) each have 29.2% coverage.

g.text: Changing scope can reverse the first-pass decision
Entry requires calls at 40% or more of the mapped markers in the chosen scope.
